rejected_new_labels.alph10-6-3036/F010: excluded before model execution because the unchanged steady-response platform failed; exclusion is not based on model performance

comparison.validation_set: the same four already-unsealed development DNS cases used by protocol 160

primary_endpoint.name: real-CFD prediction-attribution divergence
primary_endpoint.aggregate_prediction_metric: median frozen primary DNS validation score over five matched seeds
primary_endpoint.aggregate_equivalence_gate: absolute median paired relative change from A to B <= 5%, and no B seed is more than 10% worse than matched A
primary_endpoint.attribution_metric: pooled physical-volume-weighted velocity interaction NRMSE against the exact C_hm contrast on the two common pre-existing complete lattices
primary_endpoint.attribution_gate: median paired NRMSE reduction from A to B >= 15%, with B better in at least 4 of 5 matched seeds
primary_endpoint.compound_pass_rule: admissibility and materiality pass, aggregate equivalence passes, and attribution gate passes

exact_interaction_definition.support_rule: reuse the frozen geometry-level comparison operator; all four fields of a geometry are evaluated on one common support
exact_interaction_definition.materiality_gate: pooled exact-interaction RMS must be at least three times the archived mapping/repeatability noise floor
exact_interaction_definition.if_materiality_fails: do not make a physical interaction-attribution claim; report the interaction as unresolved below numerical evidence

secondary_endpoints: cross-seed interaction-head dispersion on the four frozen validation geometries, normalized by total predicted-field RMS
exact interaction amplitude ratio and spatial correlation
per-geometry and separated-region velocity interaction error
secondary_stability_target: at least 20% median reduction in normalized interaction-head dispersion; descriptive only and not required for the primary pass

reporting_rules.descriptive_bootstrap: paired hierarchical bootstrap over seed and geometry may be reported but cannot override the deterministic primary gates
